rundown.desc: Simulasi partikel kompleks, pyro, dan fluid rendering dengan workstation ultra-high performance.

rundown.title: Class 3: Enterprise AI & Neural Rendering
rundown.speaker: Dr. Sarah Chen, AI Research Director
rundown.desc: Implementasi local LLM, generative vision, dan inference workflow cepat di environment studio.

rundown.speaker: Kevin Pratama, Technical Director
rundown.desc: Nanite & Lumen real-time stress test pada scene sample peserta terpilih secara langsung.
